articles.summary: At Brooks Pierce, Shannon DeGennaro, Director of Recruiting and Professional Development, found that simplifying was the key to scaling. When she sat down with Flo Content Manager Elizabeth Greiner, Shannon shared how her team uses Flo to manage everything from partner hiring to law student recruiting, proving that a single, centralized system setup can deliver the flexibility and polish needed for every kind of candidate.
articles.title: From Law Students to Lateral Partners: How Brooks Pierce Unifies Hiring with Flo Recruit
